name: Paulownia
source:
She grew up in a single-parent household, but her mother was often ill and the family's finances were always difficult.
In order to help her younger sister Charlene go to college, she lied about her age and started working in nightclubs after graduating from junior high school.
After working at several clubs, she moved to the Amaryllis nightclub at the age of 18.
When she was 19, a customer named Chan became obsessed with her, and he was eventually banned from the club.
She was a fan of burlesque dancer Panther and had a physical relationship with him.
After the death of Panther's girlfriend, she became his emotional support, got married, and had a child.
After the birth of her child, Chan learned of the incident and began harassing her again, and she sought help from Yvet.
